transitInfo: TransLink Bus #227 (Lynn Valley Centre / Phibbs Exchange) stops at Peters Rd & Duval Rd, or Bus #228 to Lynn Valley Rd & Peters Rd (approx. 10-15 min walk to park entrance). Connect via Phibbs Exchange or Lonsdale Quay SeaBus.

coffee_benchmark: $4.25 CAD (12oz drip / Americano at Lynn Canyon Cafe)
meal_benchmark: $12.50 CAD (Fresh sandwich or hot soup and baked item combo at Lynn Canyon Cafe)

spend_benchmarks.coffee: $4.25 CAD (12oz drip / Americano at Lynn Canyon Cafe)
spend_benchmarks.meal: $12.50 CAD (Fresh sandwich or hot soup and baked item combo at Lynn Canyon Cafe)

weekly_hours: Daily: 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM (Park grounds vary seasonally from 7:00 AM to dusk; Ecology Centre open Daily 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM)
payment_methods: Tap debit, major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), mobile pay (Apple Pay / Google Pay) at Cafe and Ecology Centre; park admission and suspension bridge are free
step_free_entrance: Paved and ramped paths connect the main parking lot, Lynn Canyon Ecology Centre, Lynn Canyon Cafe, and central washroom pavilion. The suspension bridge itself is accessible via boardwalk ramps, though natural trails past the bridge feature steep wooden stairs, exposed roots, and uneven terrain.
elevator_lift: not_applicable
accessible_washrooms: Wheelchair-accessible public washrooms located at the main park entrance pavilion adjacent to the Ecology Centre.
service_animals: Service animals certified under the BC Guide Dog and Service Dog Act are permitted throughout the park and inside the Ecology Centre. Pets are permitted on-leash on main trails, with designated off-leash trail sections available.
outside_food_policy: outside_food_permitted (Designated picnic tables and open green spaces available near the main entrance; pack-it-in pack-it-out waste and wildlife awareness policies strictly enforced; alcohol and open fires prohibited)
on_site_fnb: Lynn Canyon Cafe is situated near the park entrance offering espresso, hot drinks, sandwiches, baked goods, and casual lunch items. Water refill station available outside the washroom facility.
